description:
## What is a Branch?

A **Branch** is a single franchise location — one physical school building plus everything that operates inside it. It links upward to a Cluster and downward to one or more Campuses (Kids / Junior / Senior).

A Branch is the level at which permission scoping kicks in: Branch Admins, Accountants and Principals only see data tagged to their Branch.

Use a short, stable **code** (e.g. `BR-001`) — it is referenced everywhere else in the system.
